name: Rock-Trader-Neuro
summary: This EA uses a single-layer artificial neuron with hyperbolic tangent activation to generate trading signals from Bollinger Band indicator values. It normalizes the ratio of Bollinger Band width to base line across 7 bars as neuron inputs, buys when the neuron output is negative, and sells when positive. Positions are managed with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA使用单层人工神经元（双曲正切激活函数）基于布林带指标值生成交易信号。它将7根K线的布林带宽度与基准线的比值归一化后作为神经元输入，神经元输出为负时买入，为正时卖出，并使用固定止损止盈管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于单层感知器神经网络，利用布林带的上轨、下轨和基准线数据作为输入特征。入场条件为：当神经元输出值小于0时开多单，大于0时开空单。神经元输入是对布林带宽度（上轨减下轨）与基准线之比进行归一化处理后的值，共7个输入对应14个数组元素（每个输入配一个权重）。出场条件完全依赖固定止损（30点）和止盈（100点），没有动态止盈或移动止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数（默认1手），没有根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面仅检查是否已有同方向持仓，防止重复开仓，但未考虑总仓位风险或最大回撤控制。权重参数(w0-w13)为硬编码输入参数，缺乏自适应训练或优化机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a single-layer perceptron neural network using Bollinger Band upper, lower, and base line data as input features. Entry conditions are: open a buy when the neuron output is less than 0, and open a sell when the neuron output is greater than 0. The neuron inputs are normalized values of the Bollinger Band width (upper minus lower) divided by the base line across 7 bars, with 7 inputs mapped to 14 array elements (each input paired with a weight). Exit conditions rely entirely on fixed stop loss (30 pips) and take profit (100 pips), with no dynamic trailing stop or partial close mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (default 1.0 lot) with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management only checks for existing same-direction positions to prevent duplicate entries, but does not consider total portfolio risk or maximum drawdown limits. The weight parameters (w0-w13) are hardcoded input parameters with no adaptive training or optimization mechanism.
pros: 使用神经网络概念进行信号生成，具有一定的创新性
利用布林带多维度数据（上轨、下轨、基准线）作为特征输入
有新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线重复交易
对5位/3位报价的货币对自动调整止损止盈点数
pros_en: Innovative use of neural network concept for signal generation
Utilizes multi-dimensional Bollinger Band data (upper, lower, base) as feature inputs
New bar detection mechanism prevents redundant trades on the same bar
Automatic stop loss/take profit adjustment for 5/3 digit price brokers
cons: 单层感知器网络过于简单，表达能力有限，无法捕捉非线性市场特征
14个权重参数中只有7个输入有效对应，权重数组大小与输入数组大小不匹配（inputs数组中奇数索引未被赋值）
缺乏神经网络训练机制，权重完全依赖手动设置，无法自适应市场变化
没有点差过滤，在点差较大时仍可能开仓
归一化公式存在潜在除零风险，当x_maxx+x_max等于x_min+x_minn时会导致除零错误
反向平仓逻辑缺失，多空转换时不会自动平掉反向仓位
cons_en: Single-layer perceptron is too simplistic with limited expressiveness, unable to capture non-linear market features
Only 7 of 14 inputs are effectively mapped — odd-indexed elements of the inputs array are never assigned, causing a mismatch between input and weight array sizes
No neural network training mechanism — weights rely entirely on manual setting with no adaptability to market changes
No spread filter — trades can be opened even when the spread is unusually wide
Normalization formula has potential division-by-zero risk when x_maxx+x_max equals x_min+x_minn
Missing reverse position closing logic — does not automatically close opposite positions when signal reverses
improvements: 修复inputs数组赋值逻辑，确保所有14个元素都有有效值，或调整为7输入7权重的匹配结构
添加点差过滤机制，在点差超过阈值时禁止开仓
引入神经网络在线训练或定期优化机制，使权重能随市场变化自适应调整
增加归一化计算中的除零保护，当分母接近零时使用替代值
实现反向信号自动平仓功能，在多空转换时平掉现有持仓
improvements_en: Fix the inputs array assignment logic to ensure all 14 elements receive valid values, or restructure to a 7-input/7-weight matching architecture
Add a spread filter mechanism to prevent opening positions when spread exceeds a threshold
Introduce online neural network training or periodic optimization so weights can adapt to changing market conditions
Add division-by-zero protection in normalization calculations, using fallback values when the denominator approaches zero
Implement automatic reverse position closing when signal direction changes, closing existing positions before opening opposite ones

risk_points: inputs数组奇数索引未被赋值，导致神经元计算使用未初始化的值（可能为0），使14个权重中只有7个真正生效
归一化公式存在除零风险
固定手数无动态调整，大仓位可能在不利行情中造成重大亏损
没有点差过滤，高波动时段点差扩大可能导致不利成交
risk_points_en: Odd-indexed elements of the inputs array are never assigned, causing the neuron to compute with uninitialized values (likely zero), effectively making only 7 of 14 weights functional
Division-by-zero risk in the normalization formula
Fixed lot size with no dynamic adjustment — large positions could cause significant losses in adverse markets
No spread filter — wide spreads during high-volatility periods could result in unfavorable fills
